text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Those participating in the futsal match, 
please proceed to the right. Those 
attending with small children—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We have a growing lost and found! For any 
inquiries, please visit the special tent 
by the entrance—

—The day of the fan meeting. Amidst the 
massive crowd, the committee members had 
been busily on the move since morning.

The busier one is, the faster time seems 
to fly by—

And before long, it was already time for 
the evening live performance to begin.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Everything has gone smoothly so far. No 
major issues.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You too. It would be nice if we could 
wrap things up without any trouble, but—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You're...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I came! As one of Ayabe-san's fans, 
I couldn't miss this till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Like I said before, I'm behind the 
scenes. I won't be standing on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
? But this fan meeting was created by you 
working together with everyone... and this 
stage is the grand finale, right?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to see it through to the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I better get going... My friends are 
waiting for me. Well then, I'll be 
cheering for you till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Good luck! And also...! I'm so glad to be 
your fan, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Why thank me? Today, the ones who 
should be thanking them... is us.

A fan meeting meant to convey gratitude. 
Front stage or backstage, it made no 
difference. Seeing someone work so 
desperately to make it succeed would move 
any fan.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...She was really... happy, wasn't she.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Just in case, I'll go 
check the equipment one more time—

Darkness envelops the surroundings. It 
seems an equipment malfunction has caused 
the lights to go out. The area quickly 
stirs into a worried commotion.

At this rate, things are going to get bad. 
It looks like it will take some time to 
restore power, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
...I-Is it going to be okay? Everyone 
worked so hard preparing for this. 
...Ayabe-san... must be so upset right 
now...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone. We apologize for the 
inconvenience caused by this equipment 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text: !? Th-That voice is...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We are currently dealing with the issue as 
quickly as possible. Until it is fixed... 
would you mind keeping me company with a 
bit of idle talk?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The stars in the sky, usually hidden by 
the bright city lights, are just a little 
bit easier to see today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Please look up. Can you spot that single 
star shining particularly bright above—?

That voice is without a doubt—Admire Vega. 
As she speaks of the stars floating in the 
sky, the anxiety spreading through the 
crowd begins to fade.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The stars carry many tales. Gentle 
stories, sorrowful stories, valiant 
stories. Please allow me... to share just 
a few with you.

Until the lights came back on, everyone 
listened intently. Enveloped in such 
tranquility, it was as if no trouble had 
ever occurred at all.

And so, the live show was successfully 
held, finally reaching its closing 
moments. Mingled with the chants for an 
encore, one could hear—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-saaan!! Thank you, thank you... 
*sob*, thank you so much, aaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, it's an encore! They're calling 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's... not really calling for me 
specifically...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's go!! All together now... it's time 
for an encore!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Fine, then. It is an encore, 
after all.

Upon the glittering stage, the horse girls 
gift everyone their smiles.

—And so, amidst the highest peak of 
excitement, the fan meeting drew its 
curtains to a close.
